meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 在 Mac 菜单栏加入一个闪电图标，显示 NanoClaw 状态：绿点=运行，红点=停止。点击图标可启动、停止或重启服务，并查看日志。
howto.when: 当用户要求给 NanoClaw 添加菜单栏状态指示器或图标时触发；仅适用于 macOS。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Mac 菜单栏状态指示器。
say.note: 技能会开始检查和安装。

say.text: 帮我装上 NanoClaw 的菜单栏图标，点它可以停止或重启。
say.note: 菜单栏会出现控制选项。

say.text: 用 /add-macos-statusbar 给 NanoClaw 建状态栏。
say.note: 相当于直接调用该技能。

howto.what_en: Adds a persistent bolt icon to the macOS menu bar for NanoClaw. The icon shows a green dot when running and a red dot when stopped, with Start, Stop, Restart and View Logs controls.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a macOS menu bar status indicator or icon for NanoClaw. Works only on macOS.

say_en.text: Add a Mac menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: The skill will check the environment and install it.

say_en.text: Install a NanoClaw menu bar icon I can use to stop or restart it.
say_en.note: Menu bar shows the control options.

say_en.text: Use /add-macos-statusbar to create a status bar for NanoClaw.
